claim: In the matching retail DLL, MatchMain.ProcessMatchEnd_Normal (0x06004928) is an instance method with parameters match_result and pl_idx_winner and an exact 261-byte body. It resolves PlayerMan.inst.GetPlObj(pl_idx_winner), tests the result through UnityEngine.Object.op_Implicit, and returns when false. It writes MatchEvaluation.inst.PlResult[pl_idx_winner].resultPosition=0. When the resolved player's plController.kind equals raw 2 it writes this.exitTimer=900. It then scans raw player indices 0 through 7. Each iteration resolves PlayerMan.inst.GetPlObj(index), skips null-converting or isSleep-nonzero players, then selects MatchEvaluation.inst.PlResult[index]. When index differs from pl_idx_winner, the emitted branches write resultPosition=1 when the scanned player's Group equals the winner player's Group; otherwise, when the scanned player's hasRight is nonzero, they write resultPosition=2 and Player.isLoseAndStop=1; otherwise they write resultPosition=3. For every non-null, non-sleeping scanned player, including the winner index, the method calls PlResult[index].finishTime.Set(this.matchTime). After the raw 0..7 loop it writes this.isMatchEnd=1 and MatchEvaluation.inst.ResultType=match_result, then returns. FACT-0093 pins the already-canonical caller at Referee.ProcesskMatchEnd_Normal IL+0x0096 with this.matchResult and the selected raw player index.
